subject: Request: add pass-through egress + SOW split to Order Form
messages:
From: Carlos Ramos <carlos@novatech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novatech.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Add pass-through egress and SOW split to Order Form

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our infra / procurement sync — we've started to see material third-party egress charges on some of our inference traffic (CloudProvider egress and inter-region replication) that we didn't forecast into the order form rates. Procurement has asked if we can: 1) add a pass-through clause in the Order Form to bill cloud egress as a separate reimbursable item, and 2) split the Statement of Work so the managed operations piece is a separately priced deliverable (we want clear hours/SLAs for ops vs. platform onboarding).

High level asks:
- Add language to Order Form that allows NovaTech to be invoiced for third-party cloud egress costs on a monthly true-up basis, with attachable receipts.
- Add a SOW exhibit that separates Implementation (fixed) from Managed Ops (time & materials or monthly retainer).
- Clarify amortization of the one-time setup fee across the first 12 months (customer prefers this).

Procurement wants a redline and indicative pricing by next Thursday so they can include it in their budget presentation.

Attached: nova_change_request_v1.pdf (pdf) — contains sample egress statements and the SOW outline.

Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood's legal needs anything specific for pass-through wording?

Thanks,
Carlos Ramos
Director, Cloud Ops
NovaTech Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ramos <carlos@novatech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Add pass-through egress and SOW split to Order Form

Carlos — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We can accommodate this; below are two practical paths that procurement typically signs quickly. Once you confirm a preferred option I'll push redlines through Legal & Finance.

Option A — True-up pass-through (preferred for accuracy)
- Pass-through: Redwood bills third-party cloud egress costs at-cost (no markup) on a monthly invoice with copies of vendor receipts.
- Reconciliation: Monthly true-up; any under/over collection reconciled quarterly.
- SOW: Implementation as a fixed-price exhibit; Managed Ops as a monthly retainer based on estimated hours (with an overage hourly rate).

Option B — Egress reserve + reconciliation (preferred for predictable billing)
- Egress reserve: Customer pays an estimated monthly egress reserve (flat fee). Quarterly reconciliation against actual receipts; adjustments on next invoice.
- SOW: Same split, but include a 30% cap on monthly egress charge movements during the first 6 months.

Setup fee amortization: we can amortize the one-time setup fee across 12 months on invoices or offer a split (50% upfront, remainder amortized).

I've attached a draft redline that implements both Option A and Option B as toggles so procurement can pick. See: redline_orderform.docx (docx).

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred billing model (A or B) by EOB Wed;
2) If A, I'll loop Karthik for legal wording for audit rights and receipts;
3) If B, I'll loop Finance to set the reserve threshold.

If they want me to recommend, I'd suggest Option B with a 3-month review — balances predictability and fairness.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Add pass-through egress + SOW split to Order Form

Karthik / Laura — forwarding NovaTech's request and my two-option approach. Procurement is pushing for a signed amendment next week (they want a slide in the budget deck). Can Legal prioritize review of the attached redline (ben_redlines_20260427.docx) and call out any mandatory language we must include (audit rights, confidentiality of vendor receipts, notice periods, cap language if we go with Option B).

Quick summary of the redline:
- Adds a new Exhibit X: Third-Party Costs — defines pass-through costs and monthly true-up process.
- Adds Exhibit Y: Managed Ops SOW — lists deliverables, monthly retainer, and overage hourly rate.
- Adds clause: Setup Fee Amortization over 12 months (customer requested explicit amortization wording).

Procurement said egress receipts will be provided monthly and they expect no vendor markup. If Legal wants to push for a small admin fee we should flag that now.

Appreciate a quick turn here.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Add pass-through egress + SOW split to Order Form

Ben / Laura — reviewed the redline and the NovaTech request. High-level legal comments and edits attached (legal_comments_redline.docx). Key points below — please incorporate before we send to procurement for signature: 

1) Definition + Receipts: Add a specific definition for "Third-Party Pass-Through Costs" (itemize: egress, inter-region transfer, CDN egress). Require vendor invoice/receipt attached to Redwood invoice or available via customer portal within 15 days.

2) Audit Rights: Redwood can request evidence of third-party invoices for audit purposes, but limit to once per 12 months and with 30 days' notice. If customer prefers 3rd-party portal access instead of copying invoices, allow that as an alternative.

3) Cap / Reserve: If going with Option B (reserve), add a 20% initial variance cap for the first quarter and a 90-day review. This protects both sides.

4) Confidentiality & Redaction: Allow customer to redact vendor banking details from receipts. Include a clause that vendor receipts are treated as Confidential Information.

5) SOW split: Ensure the Managed Ops exhibit includes explicit deliverables, SLAs, and month-to-month termination with 30 days' notice for the retainer. Implementation remains fixed-price with a 15% contingency for additional integration work (requires pre-approval).

6) Billing timing & Amortization: Clarify that amortization is an invoicing method (not a waiver of payment obligations) — customer remains liable for the full amount even if amortized. Provide two checkbox options in the amendment: "12-month amortization" or "50% upfront / 50% amortized".

7) Finance/Procurement items: Please run the reserve amounts and estimated monthly egress with Finance (cc'ing them when we send final). If we want to propose a nominal admin fee (1-2%), call it out as an optional toggled clause.

I've attached the marked-up redline. Once Ben confirms which Option NovaTech prefers, Legal will sign off and I will generate a DocuSign envelope.
